headline: Venezuela, RB: +9.0% growth in 2025, 252.0% inflation
sections: Venezuela, RB is a $101 billion economy (2025), the world's 77th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +9.0% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%.
